phase: Fiscal Primary Balance Reaction — Annual Structural Selection Preregistration
purpose: Preregister one parsimonious annual conditional primary-balance candidate before any coefficient estimation, using only the exact retained 1995-2024 AMECO actual-only source vintage. The cycle asks whether lagged debt and lagged cyclical position add predictive information beyond primary-balance persistence. It does not identify causal fiscal policy, discretionary policy, structural balance, or debt sustainability, and it does not activate a System Dynamics feedback.

target.concept: AMECO UBLGI general-government net lending/borrowing excluding interest
target.reason: The level specification is the conventional fiscal-reaction observable and preserves the retained source concept. A change specification is a distinct candidate family and is not searched inside this cycle.

lagged_debt.interpretation: Observed debt-to-GDP level only; it is not a gap from 60 percent or any other target.

lagged_output_gap.interpretation: Retained AMECO/EUCAM model-based output-gap estimate. Lagging is frozen ex ante to avoid using same-year cyclical information as if it were predetermined fiscal information.

parameter_interpretation.beta_d: incremental conditional association of prior-year debt-to-GDP with current primary balance; non-negative sign is the preregistered conventional fiscal-response direction but is not a causal or sustainability coefficient
parameter_interpretation.beta_y: incremental conditional association of prior-year output gap with current primary balance; non-negative sign is the preregistered cyclical direction but does not isolate discretionary policy or automatic stabilizers

information_timing.interpretation: One-year-ahead conditional prediction from previously observed annual states. AMECO release-vintage revision uncertainty remains and real-time-vintage forecasting is not claimed.

fitting_method.missing_value_policy: No imputation. A target year is evaluable only when target and every required lagged input are finite.

windows.structural_selection_method: Expanding-origin one-step-ahead predictions. At each target year, each estimable model is fitted using only earlier target years.
windows.final_evaluation_open_rule: Open final-evaluation model performance only if the candidate passes every structural-selection and identifiability gate. If it fails, 2018-2024 final-evaluation performance remains unopened and cannot rescue the form.
windows.sample_size_note: The source vintage has only 30 actual annual observations. The windows deliberately keep the candidate at four parameters, use expanding-origin evaluation, and prohibit added controls or regime coefficients inside this cycle.

identifiability_gates.rule: Rank, condition-number or coefficient-domain failure is an identification failure. Do not rescue the candidate with regularization, variable deletion, alternative lags, target differencing or regime terms inside this cycle.

structural_selection_gates.rule: The candidate passes only if every identifiability and predictive gate passes. Improvement over persistence alone is insufficient; incremental predictive value over the estimated AR baseline is mandatory.

final_evaluation_gates_if_opened.parameter_refit_policy: At each final-evaluation origin, refit the frozen model form only on target years strictly earlier than that target year; no form, lag, target, variable or gate may change.

robustness_diagnostics_not_selection_cri.note: Diagnostics may motivate a future separately preregistered cycle but may not respecify this one.

verdict_rules.PASS_TO_FINAL_EVALUATION: All structural-selection and identifiability gates pass; the frozen annual form may be evaluated on 2018-2024.
verdict_rules.FAIL_BEFORE_HOLDOUT: Any required structural-selection or identifiability gate fails; final evaluation stays unopened.
verdict_rules.CANDIDATE_AFTER_FINAL_EVALUATION: The frozen form passes final predictive gates but remains a non-causal candidate; separate validation, regime robustness and System Dynamics activation gates are still required.
verdict_rules.REJECT_TESTED_FORM: The frozen annual form fails permitted evaluation. This rejects this form within this cycle, not the general possibility of fiscal adjustment to debt or cyclical conditions.

estimation_authorization.next_gate: Implement an offline runner that exactly enforces this frozen contract, add synthetic/unit tests and a default no-estimation guard. Only after CI verification may one bounded structural-selection execution be separately authorized.
